top_signals.title: Iran Claims Seven Ships Hit in Persian Gulf as Oil Prices Surge
top_signals.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy on Thursday claimed that seven vessels, including oil tankers, were either hit by Iranian forces or struck mines in the Persian Gulf over the past day, as tensions in the region flared up again this week.   The IRGC Navy said that its forces had tracked and hit four tankers carrying out oil transfers in the northern Persian Gulf, while three other vessels hit mines west of the Strait of Hormuz.   The IRGC Navy also warned the United States that continued provocations could lead…

top_signals.title: Ofgem Approves Deal to Keep UK Gas Import Capacity From Europe
top_signals.summary: The UK’s energy market regulator, Ofgem, is looking to keep Britain’s gas import capacity from mainland European connectors to preserve flexibility to import gas in case of strong demand. Ofgem on Thursday approved Interconnector Limited entering into an agreement, under its license, with National Gas Transmission plc to reinforce gas import capability through the Great Britain-Belgium interconnector. The UK is connected to mainland Europe with several interconnectors, through which gas can flow in both directions depending on where…
